scripts.prebuild: node --input-type=module -e "const { rm } = await import('node:fs/promises'); await rm(new URL('./dist/', import.meta.url), { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test:exports: node --input-type=module -e "const root = await import('@beonedge/contracts'); const scalars = await import('@beonedge/contracts/scalars'); const envelope = await import('@beonedge/contracts/envelope'); const errors = await import('@beonedge/contracts/errors'); const publicContracts = await import('@beonedge/contracts/public'); if (root.Uuid !== scalars.Uuid || root.ErrorEnvelope !== envelope.ErrorEnvelope || root.ErrorCode !== errors.ErrorCode || root.PUBLIC_OPERATIONS !== publicContracts.PUBLIC_OPERATIONS) throw new Error('Package export mismatch')"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run test:exports
